pv51:1.1: Kin nu ummattarūpo va migo bhanto va dhāvasi nissaṃsayaṃ pāpakammanto kin nu saddāyase tuvaṃ. || || Ahaṃ
pv51:2.1: bhadante peto 'mhi duggato Yamalokiko pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokam ito gato. || ||
pv51:3.1: Saṭṭhikūṭasahassāni paripuṇṇāni sabbaso sīse mayhaṃ nipatanti te bhindanti ca matthakaṃ. || || Kin
pv51:4.1: nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kaṭaṃ kissa kammacipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
pv51:5.1: Saṭṭhikūṭasahassāni paripuṇṇāni sabbaso sīse tuyhaṃ nipatanti te bhindanti ca matthakaṃ. || || Ath'
pv51:6.1: addasāsim sambuddhaṃ Sunettaṃ bhāvitindriyaṃ nisinnaṃ rukkhamūlasmiṃ jhāyantam akutobhayaṃ. || ||
pv51:7.1: Sālittakappahārena bhindissaṃ tassa matthakaṃ tassa kammavipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchisaṃ. || ||
pv51:8.1: Saṭṭhikūṭasahassāni paripuṇṇāni sabbaso sīse mayhaṃ nipatanti te bhindanti ca matthakaṃ. || || Dhammena
pv51:9.1: te kāpurisa, saṭṭhikūṭasahassāni paripuṇṇāni sabbaso sīse tuyham nipatanti te bhindanti ca matthakan ti. || ||
pv51:13.1: Ambasakkharo Serīsako Piṅgalo Revati-ucchukhādakā dve kumārā dve gūthā gaṇa-Pāṭali-pokkharañ ca akkharukkha-bhogasaṃharā
pv51:14.1: seṭṭhiputta-sālittakā iti soḷasavatthūni vaggo tena pavaccatī ti. Petavatthu
